evals.expected_output: A structured XState v5 review that identifies convention violations, proposes a typed setup/createMachine and fromPromise design, distinguishes team policy from official behavior, and cites exact official documentation or source locations.
assertions: The response contains Summary, severity-labeled Violations, Recommendations, and Positive aspects sections
Each violation names the applicable bundled convention and includes both the problematic code and a corrected example

The test recommendation prioritizes observable transitions, invoked side effects, or failure/retry behavior rather than mechanically restating every transition

evals.prompt: Audit this React integration for an XState v5 page-local wizard. The app currently places WizardActorContext.Provider at the application root, reads `snapshot.context` inline in six components, and subscribes to `wizard.completed` in useEffect without returning the subscription cleanup. The wizard should have one independent actor per mounted WizardForm. Recommend the appropriate ActorContext or component-lifecycle pattern and show the key corrected code.
evals.expected_output: A structured review recommending a component 1:1 useActor/provide lifecycle for independent wizard instances, selectors where appropriate, and subscription cleanup, supported by official @xstate/react evidence and clearly labeled team conventions.
assertions: The response explains why an app-root shared Provider conflicts with one independent actor per WizardForm and recommends the component 1:1 lifecycle pattern
The corrected example uses useActor with machine.provide() or an equivalently scoped XState v5 actor implementation
The response addresses reusable selectors or a facade boundary instead of endorsing repeated inline context access
The event subscription example returns or invokes unsubscribe during effect cleanup
Official @xstate/react claims are cited to specific documentation or source locations and team-policy conventions are not misrepresented as official requirements
